MIND. [1] [Coff. t.]
She is greatly excited and is sure she will die. θ Labor.
Full of apprehension of terrible things happening.
Begs that some one might end her life. θ Labor.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Coff. t.]
Migraine comes on in morning shortly after awaking, and increases little by little ; pains become intolerable and sometimes burning ; integuments of head sensitive, hurt when touched ever so slightly ; body and mind excessively sensitive ; looks exhausted ; retires to lonely and dark places and closes eyes in order to avoid light ; remains seated in an arm-chair, or stretched upon bed ; least noise or motion excites pain ; avoids talking or being talked to or hearing others talk ; body is colder than usual, although no chills are experienced ; hands and feet are especially very cold ; loathes all food and drinks on account of continual sickness at stomach ; if attack is very violent, vomiting of mucus takes place, which, however, does not diminish headache ; there are no alvine discharges ; pain scarcely ever ceases before evening ; attacks come on irregularly, without premonitory symptoms.
Periodic headache of hysterical women.
Nervous and gastric headaches.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Coff. t.]
Eyes shining. θ Labor.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Coff. t.]
Paleness of face. θ Vertigo with fainting.
Face hot and deeply flushed. θ Labor.
Excruciating facial neuralgia from decayed teeth ; patient not in habit of taking coffee.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Coff. t.]
Cramp of stomach.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Coff. t.]
Cramplike drawing in umbilical region, with severe pains in small of back. θ Labor.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Coff. t.]
Diarrhœa from overwork and too much care.
Obstinate diarrhœa of old people occurring after an attack of cholera.
Obstinate chronic diarrhœa.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Coff. t.]
Very severe labor pains, patient becoming greatly excited ; constant tossing about with violent movements of extremities ; she complains of the severity of pains and is sure she will die ; face deeply flushed and bloated ; eyes shining ; small and frequent pulse.
Twenty-four hours after rupture of bag of waters, very severe pains in small of back, with cramplike drawing in umbilical region ; pulse small and frequent ; face red ; head and body excessively hot and dry ; she tosses about, greatly excited, begging that some one would end her life.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Coff. t.]
Palpitation of heart. θ Vertigo with fainting.
Palpitation from irritable heart.
Small and frequent pulse. θ Labor.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Coff. t.]
Very severe pains in small of back, with cramplike drawing in umbilical region. θ Labor.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Coff. t.]
Trembling of hands.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Coff. t.]
Iliac pains.
   

NERVES. [36] [Coff. t.]
General nervous excitement.
Pain in head with depression of spirits due to indigestion from weakness of nervous system produced by overexertion.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Coff. t.]
Obstinate sleeplessness.
   

FEVER. [40] [Coff. t.]
Inflammatory fever in children, with excitability, starting and twitching in sleep, restlessness and crying.
